definitions.explanation: A person or figure in a story, anime, manga, game, or other fictional work.
A designed character used as a mascot or brand representative, including corporate mascots, regional mascots, and product characters.

examples.japanese: ⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧なキャラクター⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧？
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦アニメ→アニメ：01527_anime⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧キャラクター⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{個性的|こせいてき}→個性的：14922_koseiteki⟧だ。

notes:
From English 'character'. Very frequently shortened to ⟦キャラ→キャラ：08916_kyara⟧ in casual speech. In Japanese, this word primarily refers to fictional or mascot characters, not to personality or moral character (which would be ⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧ or ⟦{人格|じんかく}→人格：11427_jinkaku⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- キャラクター⟦グッズ→グッズ：10800_guzzu⟧: character merchandise
- ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧キャラクター: popular character
- ⟦{公式|こうしき}→公式：04167_koushiki⟧キャラクター: official character/mascot
- ⟦ご{当地|とうち}→ご当地：08936_gotouchi⟧キャラクター: local mascot character (regional mascot)
- キャラクター⟦デザイン→デザイン：03860_dezain⟧: character design
- キャラクター⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{演|えん}じる→演じる：13330_enjiru⟧: to play/portray a character

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan has a rich culture of mascot characters (ゆる⟦キャラ→キャラ：08916_kyara⟧). Almost every prefecture, city, company, and organization has its own character. Famous examples include くまモン (Kumamoto Prefecture) and ふ⟦なっ→なる：01970_naru⟧しー (Funabashi City).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦キャラ→キャラ：08916_kyara⟧: character — the casual abbreviated form, extremely common in spoken Japanese
- ⟦{登場人物|とうじょうじんぶつ}→登場人物：16072_toujoujinbutsu⟧: character (in a story) — a more formal, literary term
- マスコット: mascot — focuses on the mascot role rather than the character design
